name: Cascajal Block
notes: Discovered in the late 1990s near Lomas de Tacamichapan, Veracruz, in a debris pile — not found in situ/stratified excavation. The ~900 BCE date rests on associated pottery/figurine dating, not direct stratigraphy of the block itself. Authenticity is disputed (David Grove, Christopher Pool have voiced skepticism; Englehardt et al. 2020 material-science analysis supports genuine Formative-period manufacture without resolving the stratigraphic-context problem). Never read; UNDECIPHERED regardless of the authenticity question. See claim_cascajal_authenticity_disputed.
